stage: board infrastructure: how weights can reach DDR, and how much DDR exists
why: the compiled model needs its parameters resident in DDR, and nothing in model/ had established that the infrastructure can preload them

single_image_path.what: examples/FPGA-BOSCAME/fpga_run.sh uploads one .bin and the platform loads it with `writemem -rtl nanhu_xilinx.i_ddr[16383:0]`

measured.padding: UV_RUN_ALIGN_BYTES=1048576, UV_RUN_MIN_BYTES=1048576 -> every image is padded up to 1 MiB
measured.window: 1048576 / 16384 = 64 bytes per element, and the range is hardcoded in user_script_nr/hw_run.tcl

single_image_path.conclusion: the single-image path preloads at most 1 MiB at 0x80000000; it cannot carry model weights

multi_segment_path.what: the platform also ships a DDR load-plan loader, reachable from the remote Makefile as `uv_run<id> layout=<plan>`
validation_rules: ddr_base must be 0x80000000 and ddr_size must be 0x400000000 -- the platform asserts this exact range
addresses and sizes must be multiples of `alignment` (>= 64)
each segment's file size must equal the declared size and its SHA256 must match
multi_segment_path.conclusion: weights CAN be preloaded as their own segment at 0xb8000000, which is exactly where validation/weight-image.json already places them

ddr_size_finding.contrast: common/nr/nr.ld models only 768 MiB (LOW) + 1152 MiB (HIGH) = 1920 MiB, and validation/memory-plan.json inherited that
ddr_size_finding.indirect_evidence_that_memory_beyond_LOW: the operator suite allocates and uses a 640 MiB workspace at 0xb8000000 and its numerics pass on this board
ddr_size_finding.not_verified: the full 16 GiB was NOT probed; only the range the platform asserts and the ~1 GiB the operator suite already touched
ddr_size_finding.implication: the 1920 MiB ceiling in memory-plan.json is self-imposed by the linker script, not a hardware limit -- but it must not be raised on the strength of a declared constant alone

not_yet_done: fpga_run.sh has no layout-mode entry point; a model-side runner is needed to upload several segments plus the plan and invoke `make uv_run<id> layout=<plan>`
no model image or weight segment has been uploaded
the graph still takes a flat FP32 parameter buffer, so no weight segment has been wired to it yet
